network: Ethereum Sepolia, Base Sepolia, Monad Testnet, Robinhood Chain Testnet
funding: Select a network, create one wallet, manually fund its displayed native-token budget, then Start demo. ETH on Sepolia, Base Sepolia, and Robinhood Testnet; MON on Monad Testnet. See README.md.
history: Paginated on-chain PayMVC records; standard token transfers are not indexed.
confirmation: One successful mined receipt and verified application state. Recheck original receipts on recovery; no irreversible-finality claim.
